author: archivist

C1_MESSAGE_VALIDITY.title: Every outbound message MUST pass self-validation before send
rules: All top-level required fields present per inbox-message-v1.json schema
type in [task, response, heartbeat, escalation, handoff, ack, alert, notification, status]
task_kind in [proposal, review, amendment, ratification, ack, done, status, report, handoff, alert, notification, heartbeat, audit]
to field must be a single valid lane name (archivist|library|swarmmind|kernel) or omitted
timestamp must be valid ISO-8601 UTC
NO to:'all' — use fan-out per-lane copies instead
C1_MESSAGE_VALIDITY.violation_remedy: Do not send. Fix or escalate to coordinator.

C2_PIPELINE_ORDER.title: Every incoming message MUST pass through gates in fixed order

pipeline.name: COMPLETION_GATE
pipeline.action: Has completion proof or is terminal/exempt

C2_PIPELINE_ORDER.compliance_check: Run test suite: 12-step pipeline with known-good and known-bad inputs

C3_NACK_BEHAVIOR.title: Every rejected message MUST receive a NACK back to sender
rules: NACK generated on quarantine or blocked routing
NACK schema_version: 1.3, type: notification, priority: P2
NACK body includes: original task_id, rejection reason, gate that rejected
NACK delivered to sender's canonical lane inbox: lanes/{sender}/inbox/nack-{original_task_id}.json
NACK delivery verified (file exists at canonical path after write)
C3_NACK_BEHAVIOR.compliance_check: Send invalid message → verify NACK arrives at sender inbox within 2x poll interval

C4_LEASE_OWNERSHIP.title: Message leasing and lane-worker ownership semantics
rules: Every message MUST have lease block with: owner, acquired_at, expires_at, renew_count, max_renewals=3
Lane worker MUST write active-owner.json to lanes/{lane}/state/ with session_id + origin_runtime + origin_workspace
Lease timeout: 900s (15 min) from acquired_at. Worker MUST re-claim before expiry.
Cross-instance guard: actionable messages with foreign _lane_worker.session_id route to stale-foreign/
Ownership enforcement: if --enforce-ownership flag active, owner mismatch → blocked
C4_LEASE_OWNERSHIP.compliance_check: Check active-owner.json freshness on startup + poll cycle

C5_HEARTBEAT_SLA.title: Heartbeat schema and freshness requirements
rules: Every lane MUST write heartbeat-{lane}.json to own inbox at interval ≤ 60s
Heartbeat schema_version: 1.3, type: heartbeat, priority: P3
heartbeat.status field required: one of [pending, in_progress, done, failed, escalated, timed_out]
heartbeat.last_heartbeat_at MUST be valid ISO-8601 UTC timestamp
Freshness SLA: heartbeat age ≤ 900s = alive, > 900s = stale, > 3600s = dead
No heartbeat file present = dead lane
C5_HEARTBEAT_SLA.compliance_check: Scan all 4 lane heartbeat files at recovery test interval

C6_SOVEREIGNTY_SOURCE.title: Sovereignty enforcement rule source and versioning
rules: Sovereignty enforcer source: S:/SwarmMind/scripts/sovereignty-enforcer.js (canonical)
All lanes MUST use the same enforcer logic (can copy, but must track version hash)
Enforcer MUST detect cross-lane require() with hardcoded S:/<other-lane-root> paths
Allowed patterns: ./.., ../.., node_modules/, .global/, util/, absolute local paths
Pre-commit hook MUST run sovereignty-enforcer.js with --strict flag
Version hash of enforcer MUST be stored in sovereignty report for traceability
C6_SOVEREIGNTY_SOURCE.compliance_check: Run same enforcer against all 4 repos, verify identical violation counts

C7_ADMISSION_GATES.title: Messages must pass all applicable gates before reaching processed/
rules: No message enters processed/ without: valid schema, ASCII body, valid signature, evidence check passed, completion gate passed
Actionable messages (requires_action=true) may enter action-required/ without proof, but NOT processed/
No fake proofs accepted: messages with terminal_decision but no artifact_path → blocked
Evidence exchange block required when evidence.required=true for response/ack types
C7_ADMISSION_GATES.compliance_check: Audit processed/ for any message missing required gate validation

C8_OUTBOUND_SELF_CHECK.title: Validate own outbound messages before delivery to target lane
rules: Before writing to target lane inbox, sender MUST validate the message against C1 requirements
If self-check fails, message is NOT delivered. Fix and retry.
Self-check failure logged to sender's outbox as aborted-{task_id}.json
Delivery verification: after write to canonical path, verify file exists with matching content hash
C8_OUTBOUND_SELF_CHECK.compliance_check: Audit lane outbox for aborted records; should be zero for operational lanes

C9_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: Lane worker polling interval standard
rules: Recommended poll interval: 30s (balanced between responsiveness and filesystem churn)
Minimum allowed: 20s
Maximum allowed: 60s
Any deviation must be documented with reason in lane's AGENTS.md
C9_POLLING_INTERVAL.compliance_check: Check lane-worker --poll-seconds config against documented value

C10_REPRODUCIBILITY.title: Lane must declare runtime dependencies
rules: Every lane SHOULD have package.json with pinned dependency versions
Node.js version SHOULD be documented
CI SHOULD verify `node scripts/lane-worker.js --dry-run --apply-once` passes smoke test
Recovery test suite SHOULD run pre-compact and post-compact
C10_REPRODUCIBILITY.compliance_check: Verify package.json exists with node engine field
